title: Calming the Storm
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Mark 4:35-41: crossing the lake, a furious storm, Jesus asleep on a cushion, the frightened disciples wake him, he says "Quiet! Be still!", the sea is calm, he asks about their faith; and explains challenges Christians face today and that Jesus is with them.

floor.question: What did Jesus do on the lake at night?

representations: a boat in waves drawn on the board
steps: They set out across the lake.
He calms it and asks about their faith.

board.do: Draw a boat in big waves and a figure asleep.

board.say: What did the disciples say when they woke Jesus?

board.do: Wait for the child to say "Don't you care if we drown?"
Write "Quiet! Be still!" and draw calm water.

misconceptions.ask: What was Jesus doing when the storm began?
What can a Christian learn from the calming of the storm?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: were the disciples in the storm with Jesus in the boat?

misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus ask the disciples after the storm (Mark 4:40)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 4:39-40 and stop after each verse: first the wind, then the disciples.

checks.question: Name a challenge Christians face today.
